zh.title: 日本航空10月8日重開羽田第一航廈北翼翻新貴賓室
zh.summary: 日本航空重開羽田北翼翻新國內線貴賓室與安檢通道；Diamond Premier Lounge更名JAL First Class Lounge
body: 日本航空（Japan Airlines, JAL）宣佈，將於2026年10月8日重新開放東京羽田機場（HND）第一航廈北翼的翻新國內線貴賓室及專用安檢通道。
日本航空表示，此次重新開放完成了北翼優先出發設施的翻新，繼2026年7月24日推出新的專用報到櫃檯之後。
作為更新的一部分，JAL已將其「Diamond Premier Lounge」更名為「JAL First Class Lounge」。同樣的品牌變更將逐步推廣到新千歲機場（CTS）、大阪伊丹機場（ITM）、福岡機場（FUK）及那霸機場（OKA）。
兩間貴賓室皆重新設計，設有獨立用餐、放鬆及工作區域。JAL表示，JAL First Class Lounge的座位數約增至1.4倍。

en.title: Japan Airlines to reopen renovated domestic lounges at Tokyo Haneda on October 8
en.summary: Japan Airlines will reopen its renovated domestic lounges and a dedicated security checkpoint in Terminal 1 North Wing at Tokyo Haneda Airport (HND) on October 8, 2026.
body: Japan Airlines (JAL) has announced it will reopen its renovated domestic lounges and a dedicated security checkpoint in the North Wing of Terminal 1 at Tokyo Haneda Airport (HND) on October 8, 2026.
The reopening completes the overhaul of the North Wing's priority departure facilities, following the launch of new dedicated check-in counters on July 24, 2026.

As part of the update, JAL has renamed its Diamond Premier Lounge the JAL First Class Lounge. The same change will be rolled out progressively at New Chitose Airport (CTS), Osaka Itami Airport (ITM), Fukuoka Airport (FUK) and Naha Airport (OKA).
Both lounges have been redesigned around dedicated areas for dining, relaxation and work. JAL said the JAL First Class Lounge has increased seating capacity by about 1.4 times.
